summary: Frontend-only e2e for iteration 4 (email alert admin + therapy image override). All requested flows PASS: (a) Passwordless persona login works for parent/staff/admin; (b) Admin Settings 'New enquiry email alerts': notify-status starts 'Not configured', test-notify disabled, password field type=password. After entering center@example.com / sender@gmail.com / 16-char password and clicking Save, status becomes 'On', password input cleared, placeholder switches to saved indicator, and test-notify becomes enabled. (c) Clicking 'Send test email' fires the request and surfaces an error toast (Cloudflare 502 because the fake Gmail creds can't actually send) - acceptable per request. (d) Admin Media therapy card upload for speech-therapy transitions Default photo -> Custom photo, reset button appears, and Reset reverts to Default photo. (e) Public /therapies page (same session) shows the uploaded image via /api/public/media/... URL under data-testid=service-speech-therapy. (f) Public assessment enquiry submission returns reference (MN-5BB8D7B2) with success toast.

minor.issue: With fake SMTP creds the endpoint response returns as Cloudflare 502 in browser (likely long smtplib timeout hitting proxy limit). Not a bug per spec (no real SMTP creds) but consider shortening SMTP timeout and returning JSON error instead of letting the request hang past proxy timeout.

action_items: Optional: tighten SMTP send timeout in /api/admin/notifications/test so failure returns a clean JSON error toast rather than a Cloudflare 502 page. Currently the user-facing toast says 'origin web server returned an invalid or incomplete response'.
critical_code_review_comments: AdminSettings.jsx is dense one-liner JSX (~40 char/line minified style) - readability is poor for future maintenance; consider splitting AdminSettings and AdminMedia into their own files.
notify-enabled testid is applied to the <label> wrapper; the actual checkbox is nested. Works via CSS descendant selector but exposing the input directly with the testid is safer.
test-notify endpoint may block on smtplib for the full socket timeout; wrap with a short asyncio.wait_for so browser gets JSON error quickly.
seed_data_creation: Per-browser sandbox: uploaded 1x1 PNG to therapy slot speech-therapy then reset it; saved fake notify settings (center@example.com / sender@gmail.com / 16-char pw).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All UI selectors used: notify-status, notify-enabled (label>input), notify-email, notify-smtp-user, notify-app-password, save-notify, test-notify, therapy-media-<slug>, therapy-reset-<slug>, service-<slug>. Booking modal fields have no testids - use placeholders: 'Your name', '+91', 'you@example.com' and last checkbox for consent. Test-notify with fake creds returns 502 via proxy (~30s hang); do not treat as blocker.
rca of the issue: N/A - no functional bugs. The 502 on test-notify is expected with fake SMTP credentials and is an environmental/network limit, not an implementation defect.
